subject.title: [Feature]: Add screenshot capture button to Control UI chat input (like Doubao)

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated Control UI screenshot capture button now, and what privacy/permission boundary should it use?
rationale: The implementation boundary is plausible, but collecting screen pixels from the browser or native shell is a sensitive product/security decision that automation should not choose.

options.title: Define capture boundary first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require maintainer-approved consent, cancel, preview/removal, logging/redaction, provider-retention, and supported-platform behavior before implementation.

options.title: Approve narrow browser capture
options.body: Proceed with a browser-only static screenshot capture PR that uses the existing attachment pipeline and provides real browser proof.

options.title: Defer to current attachments
options.body: Do not add a dedicated capture affordance yet and rely on paste, drop, file, photo, and camera attachments until a broader visual-context design is approved.

recommendation.title: Define capture boundary first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require maintainer-approved consent, cancel, preview/removal, logging/redaction, provider-retention, and supported-platform behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent current-main history on the Control UI chat/composer attachment path and is the best available owner for a capture-boundary decision.
